description: AdGuard Home, through its API: the names are DNS rewrites, one for each address. AdGuard Home answers them with a TTL of its own, and gives them no reverse names. A rewrite of the name that you disabled, or whose answer is not an address, is left as it is.

address.description: The address of its web interface, as http://192.168.1.2:3000.

tls_fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's certificate, as 64 hex digits, colons allowed. With it, only that certificate is accepted, valid or not, as one signed by the server itself: a certificate that changes, as at a renewal, needs its new fingerprint. Without it, the certificate must be valid.

username.description: The user of the web interface. Leave it out where AdGuard Home has no users.

zone.description: The domain the names are under, as lan.example.com. AdGuard Home has no zones: it is only what a name written alone, as nas, is completed with.
